name: Geometric dispersion constraint
description: Replaces the tripartite matching formulation with a geometric problem of selecting k points in a 3D grid such that the minimum absolute difference across all three axes between any pair is at least 1. This mathematically forces an exact cover (since k points are chosen from k coordinates), but models relying on surface matching will likely interpret it as a generic clique/independent set problem and fail to use the exact cover optimization (fixing one dimension to reduce search depth), causing a Time Limit Exceeded.
